description: This file is a fuzzing test for the net::HttpServer component, including a delegate class to handle HTTP and WebSocket events during fuzz testing.

classes.name: WaitTillHttpCloseDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for net::HttpServer that handles connection events, HTTP requests, WebSocket requests, and WebSocket messages during fuzz testing.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: The entry point for the fuzzing process, setting up the server socket, delegate, and running the event loop.

methods.name: set_server
methods.description: Sets the server instance for the delegate.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Handles new connection events, closing the connection if not accepted.

methods.name: OnHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, optionally replying with a 200 response.

methods.name: OnWebSocketRequest
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, accepting or closing based on flags.

methods.name: OnWebSocketMessage
methods.description: Handles WebSocket messages, optionally replying with a message.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles connection close events, triggers the completion closure.
